expectations.name: 01-page-written
expectations.text: The page that owns the retry rules, docs/features/payments.md, is changed.

expectations.name: 02-structure
expectations.text:
Each page the agent wrote or changed meets the map's structural rules: a declared kind, listed in its guide, links
and anchors that resolve, the kind's sections in order, a record named NNNN-<slug>.md, no rejected synonym.

expectations.name: 03-lead
expectations.text: The payments page still opens with a lead under its title, not a restatement of the title.

expectations.name: 04-reason-told
expectations.text:
The payments page says why a capture gets 5 attempts with growing pauses, told as it happened: back-to-back attempts
all timed out at the gateway's Friday peak and left pantry orders uncharged, not only a conclusion such as "for
reliability".
expectations.evidence: "During the gateway's Friday peak, 17:00 to 19:00, slow responses left 58 confirmed pantry orders uncharged. A volunteer captured them by hand the following morning. The previous three attempts ran back to back within a second, landing in the same slow period. In a sandbox replay, five attempts spaced 2, 4, 6 and 8 seconds apart would have recovered 57 of those 58 captures." This tells the incident as it happened rather than only giving a conclusion. It does not say outright that all three attempts timed out; that follows from the retry rule being about captures that time out.

expectations.name: 05-fact-stated
expectations.text: The payments page states the new rule: up to 5 attempts.

expectations.name: 06-no-new-page
expectations.text: No page is added under docs/: the change belongs to the page that already owns the retry rules.
expectations.evidence: no_match /^diff --git a/docs/\S+ b/docs/\S+\nnew file mode/ in ['diff']: no match
